enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education lectures and studying at Monash University
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Listen to lecture. Write notes. Ask question. Write more notes. Lecture ends. Stand up.
